en: The image is a sepia-toned postcard showing a public square with a tall obelisk monument topped with a double-headed eagle (likely symbolizing the Austro-Hungarian Empire). Several people, some in uniforms and some in period civilian attire, stand in front of the monument, along with a bicycle. Behind them is a row of multi-story buildings with window shutters. The lower margin contains German-language text.
